system.name: TREND (Temporal REndering with Neural fielD)
system.one_liner: Unsupervised 3D pre-training for LiDAR perception that forecasts future point clouds from the current scan through a recurrent embedding and a temporal LiDAR neural field.

content.variant_note: three sibling pretext pipelines (masked autoencoding, contrastive, temporal forecasting) in one grammar of input scan, backbone block and target, the proposed one last
content.argues: Masking and contrast assume hand-picked nuisance variability, whereas forecasting future LiDAR scans lets object motion decide what the backbone must encode.
content.subject: Three unsupervised pre-training schemes for LiDAR point clouds drawn as input, 3D backbone and target, using one real scan as the running example.

lessons.what_to_learn: Compare pretext tasks by drawing each as the same three-part chain (input, backbone, target) on the same real example, with the proposed one last, wider and tinted blue, so the reader sees only the target change.
lessons.suits: Self-supervised or pre-training papers contrasting their pretext task with a few standard ones on a modality where one real sample can be reused, such as point clouds or images.

evidence: (c) TREND explores object motion and semantic information via temporal forecasting in LiDAR sequence.
(a) Masked Autoencoding applies random masking and pre-train by reconstruction.
pre-train by pulling together positive pairs and pushing away negative pairs.

summary: TREND is an unsupervised 3D pre-training method for LiDAR perception that forecasts future scans from the current one, so object motion decides what the backbone has to encode. Figure 1 compares three pretext schemes in one grammar of input scan, 3D backbone block and target. (a) Masked autoencoding hides three squares of a point cloud and reconstructs it; (b) contrastive learning feeds two views and pulls positive pairs together while pushing negatives apart in an ellipse of blue and orange nodes; (c) TREND, last and drawn with a blue backbone, maps the current scan to point clouds at t0, t1, ..., tk. One real LiDAR scan is reused as the input, and a small legend names the grey and blue blocks pre-trained backbones.
summary_zh: TREND 通过预测未来 LiDAR 帧做无监督 3D 预训练。图1以同一画法（输入点云、3D 主干、目标）对比：(a) 掩码自编码，(b) 对比学习的正负样本对，(c) TREND 预测 t0 至 tk 时刻点云，主干为蓝色。
notes: Picture counts are read from the preview: 8 framed point-cloud tiles; the digest lists 33 placed bitmaps because the 3D block faces are also bitmaps. Which forecast scan belongs to which timestamp is not labelled individually, only the group. The pre-screen counted 10 pictures.
